new_value: The "redundant" root check in select_parent (line 593) is intentional defense-in-depth, not a bug. The comment at lines 588-592 explicitly documents why the check is kept: process_dio() already rejects DIOs for roots, but this check keeps that invariant runtime-enforced in release builds too, guarantees the set_role(DodagRole::Joined) below can never fire for a root, and prevents any partial mutation of root state. No changes needed - the design decision is documented and the check provides safety guarantees at minimal cost (single enum comparison).
